_comment: LTX-2.3 v1 shape menu (deepinfra). Two landscape shapes at 5s; each serves BOTH t2v and i2v (i2v rides the same compiled shape -- image conditioning is a per-token denoise mask, not a token-count change). Eager warm-on-boot warms exactly these. Adding/removing entries changes IMAGE_SHAPE_HASH and requires a new image tag + a matching per-model SUPPORTED_SHAPES in backend ltx.py (CI-checked). Dims MUST be multiples of 64: the LTX-2.3 two-stage refine stage requires height/width divisible by 64 (stricter than the VAE's 32) or it raises 'LTX-2 refinement requires height/width divisible by 64'. So 1080p rounds to 1920x1088 (1088=17*64) and 'nominal 720p' to 1280x704 (704=11*64, the nearest 64-multiple to 720). 10s (241f) and portrait deferred to a later menu.
